metadata.name: meridian
metadata.description: Meridian — binary stock-outcome markets on Solana

instructions.name: add_strike
docs: Provision an additional strike market intraday for an existing
ticker/day. Admin-gated; same provisioning as the initial create. (F-05)

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The USDC collateral mint (must match Config.usdc_mint).

accounts.name: mint_authority
docs: Per-market PDA: mint+freeze authority for both mints and the vault owner.
No external signer exists for it.

instructions.name: admin_settle
docs: Admin-only, time-delayed settlement fallback when the oracle path can't
run. Admin supplies the closing price (USDC base units). Idempotent. (F-04)

instructions.name: cancel_order
docs: Cancel a caller's own resting order and return its escrow. (F-03)

accounts.name: refund_to
docs: The caller's account that receives the refund: USDC for a bid, Yes for an ask.
Ownership is checked in the handler against the chosen side's mint.

instructions.name: create_strike_market
docs: Provision one stock-strike-day market: Market PDA, Yes/No mints, and the
USDC vault. Admin-gated. (F-02)

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The USDC collateral mint (must match Config.usdc_mint).

accounts.name: mint_authority
docs: Per-market PDA that is the mint+freeze authority for both mints and the
owner of the vault. No external signer exists for it.

instructions.name: grow_order_book
docs: Realloc the order book to full size and wire it into the market (enables
trading). Second half of two-step creation. Permissionless. (F-03)

accounts.name: order_book
docs: The order book PDA, reallocated up to its full `8 + INIT_SPACE` size. `realloc`
(vs `init`) keeps the existing data. `realloc::zero = false` is safe here NOT
because the runtime zeroes the appended bytes (it does not on realloc) but because
those bytes extend past the borsh `Vec` length prefixes (still 0 from init): borsh
reads only the declared element count, so the uninitialized tail is never accessed
and the book still deserializes as empty. This reasoning is borsh-encoding-specific.

instructions.name: init_order_book
docs: Create the bounded order book (at initial size) + escrow accounts.
Permissionless; first half of two-step creation (see `grow_order_book`). (F-03)

accounts.name: order_book
docs: The bounded on-chain order book for this market. Allocated at `INIT_ALLOC`
here (under the 10 KB realloc cap) and grown to full size by `grow_order_book`.

accounts.name: mint_authority
docs: Per-market PDA: owner/authority of both escrow accounts (and, elsewhere,
the vault + mints). No external signer exists for it.

accounts.name: yes_mint
docs: The market's Yes mint (escrow holds Yes tokens for resting asks).

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint, taken from the vault's mint (the vault is bound by `has_one`).

accounts.name: vault
docs: The collateralization vault — bound only to read its mint and prove the
`usdc_mint` passed is the right one. Not modified here.

accounts.name: usdc_escrow
docs: Order-book USDC escrow (resting bids). Authority = mint_authority PDA.

accounts.name: yes_escrow
docs: Order-book Yes escrow (resting asks). Authority = mint_authority PDA.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: One-time global setup. Creates the singleton `Config` PDA.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The signer initializing config; becomes the admin authority. Must be the
program's upgrade authority (enforced via `program_data` below).

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The USDC mint used as collateral across all markets.
At F-01 we only store the key, but we sanity-check it is a real,
token-program-owned account (not a zero/garbage key) so a poison value
can't be frozen into the singleton. We deliberately avoid pulling in the
full `anchor-spl` token stack here (dependency hygiene — see brief:
"justify all major dependencies"); F-02 performs full `Mint` typing and
the actual token CPIs.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA. `init` makes this idempotent — a second call
fails with the account-already-in-use error.

accounts.name: program
docs: This program's account (executable). Used to locate its program-data.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The program's ProgramData account, which holds the upgrade authority.
Anchor verifies the link program -> program_data and that `admin` is the
recorded upgrade authority.

instructions.name: match_orders
docs: Permissionless crank: settle any crossed resting bid/ask pairs. (F-03)

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Anyone may crank. Pays no funds; only triggers settlement.

instructions.name: mint_pair
docs: Deposit $1.00 USDC, receive 1 Yes + 1 No token. (F-02)

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The USDC mint (must match the vault's mint).

instructions.name: pause
docs: Admin emergency stop: halt new minting and all trading program-wide. (F-05)

instructions.name: place_order
docs: Post a limit or market order: cross the resting opposite side at price-time
priority (settling atomically), then rest the limit remainder. (F-03)

accounts.name: user_usdc
docs: Taker's USDC account (pays for buys, receives proceeds of sells).

accounts.name: user_yes
docs: Taker's Yes account (delivers Yes on sells, receives Yes on buys).

instructions.name: redeem
docs: Burn settled tokens for their payout (winning side pays $1.00 each). (F-02)

accounts.name: user_tokens
docs: The user's token account for the side being redeemed (Yes or No).
Its mint is checked against the chosen side in the handler.

accounts.name: user_usdc
docs: The user's USDC account that receives the payout. Bound to the vault's
mint and owned by the caller (defense-in-depth: payouts can't be
redirected to a third party).

instructions.name: settle_market
docs: After 4:00 PM ET: read the Pyth oracle, validate it, and write the
immutable Yes/No outcome. Permissionless and idempotent. (F-04)

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever cranks settlement (pays the tx fee). Not privileged.

accounts.name: price_update
docs: The Pyth `PriceUpdateV2` account posted via the Pyth Solana Receiver.
parsed `feed_id` must match the market's configured feed. Parsed by bytes
(no Pyth SDK dependency; see `oracle.rs`).

instructions.name: unpause
docs: Admin: lift the emergency stop, restoring minting and trading. (F-05)

types.name: Config
docs: Global configuration singleton. PDA: `[CONFIG_SEED]`.

fields.name: admin
docs: Authority allowed to create/settle/pause/override.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: The USDC mint used as collateral for every market.

fields.name: tickers
docs: Supported tickers and their oracle feed ids.

fields.name: paused
docs: Emergency switch: when true, minting and trading are blocked.

fields.name: fee_account
docs: Optional account that receives fees (if any are ever charged).
Fees must never be taken from a market vault — that would break the
collateralization invariant (ARCHITECTURE.md §7.1).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for the config account.

types.name: ConfigInitialized
docs: Emitted once when the global config is created.

types.name: InitializeConfigArgs
docs: Arguments for `initialize_config`.
`tickers` provides the per-ticker oracle feed ids. The full set of MAG7
tickers must be supplied (exactly `NUM_TICKERS`).

types.name: Market
docs: A single binary market: one stock, one strike, one trading day.
PDA: `[MARKET_SEED, ticker_index, strike_le, trading_day_le]`.

fields.name: ticker
docs: Underlying ticker.

fields.name: strike
docs: Strike price in USDC base units (6 dp). E.g. $680.00 -> 680_000_000.

fields.name: trading_day
docs: The session date this market settles for (unix timestamp, seconds).

fields.name: yes_mint
docs: SPL mint for Yes tokens (mint authority is the per-market PDA).

fields.name: no_mint
docs: SPL mint for No tokens.

fields.name: vault
docs: PDA-owned USDC collateral vault (token account).

fields.name: order_book
docs: The order book account for this market.

fields.name: pairs_minted
docs: Count of Yes/No pairs ever minted (monotonic). With `winning_redeemed`,
drives the on-chain collateralization invariant
(`vault_balance == PAYOFF_UNIT * pairs_minted - winning_redeemed`).

fields.name: winning_redeemed
docs: Total winning-token base units paid out of the vault via `redeem`.
Equals the USDC base units that have left the vault as payouts.

fields.name: state
docs: Lifecycle state.

fields.name: outcome
docs: Settlement outcome (immutable once written).

fields.name: settlement_price
docs: The closing price written at settlement (USDC base units, 6 dp).

fields.name: settled_at
docs: Timestamp settlement occurred.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for the market account.

fields.name: vault_bump
docs: PDA bump for the vault.

fields.name: mint_authority_bump
docs: PDA bump for the mint authority.

types.name: MarketCreated
docs: Emitted when a stock-strike-day market is provisioned (F-02).

types.name: MarketSettled
docs: Emitted once when a market is settled, via either path (F-04).

fields.name: settlement_price
docs: Closing price written, in USDC base units (6 dp).

fields.name: by_admin
docs: True if settled via the admin override (`admin_settle`), false if via the
permissionless oracle path (`settle_market`).

types.name: MarketState
docs: Lifecycle state of a market.

fields.name: max_fills
docs: Maximum number of fills to perform this call (compute-budget bound).

types.name: Order
docs: A single resting order on the Yes-vs-USDC book.

fields.name: owner
docs: Owner of the order (and of any escrowed funds/tokens).

fields.name: price
docs: Limit price in USDC-per-Yes, 6 dp, in `[0, PRICE_SCALE]`.

fields.name: size
docs: Remaining size in Yes-token base units.

fields.name: seq
docs: Monotonic sequence number for time priority (lower = earlier).

fields.name: side
docs: Which side this order is on.

fields.name: active
docs: Whether this slot is occupied (false = empty slot).

types.name: OrderBook
docs: The bounded, on-chain order book for one market.
PDA: `[ORDER_BOOK_SEED, market.key()]`.
Bids and asks are fixed-capacity arrays (`ORDERBOOK_N` each). Matching logic
is implemented in F-03; F-01 only freezes this shape and size. Default-derive
is intentionally NOT used (the arrays exceed the std `Default` impl bound of
32); the account is zero-initialized by Anchor `init`, which leaves all
orders with `active = false`.

fields.name: market
docs: Back-reference to the owning market.

fields.name: next_seq
docs: Monotonic counter handing out `Order::seq` values.

fields.name: bids
docs: Buy-Yes orders.

fields.name: asks
docs: Sell-Yes orders.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for the order book account.

types.name: OrderBookInitialized
docs: Emitted when the order book + escrow accounts are created for a market.

types.name: OrderCancelled
docs: Emitted when a resting order is cancelled and its escrow returned.

fields.name: refunded
docs: Escrow returned to the owner (USDC for a bid, Yes tokens for an ask).

types.name: OrderMatched
docs: Emitted for each maker order touched by a fill (taker placement or crank).

fields.name: maker_seq
docs: The resting (maker) order's sequence number.

fields.name: price
docs: Trade price (the maker's resting price), USDC-per-Yes at PRICE_SCALE.

fields.name: fill_size
docs: Yes-token base units exchanged in this fill.

fields.name: usdc_amount
docs: USDC base units exchanged in this fill.

types.name: OrderPlaced
docs: Emitted when an order (or the unfilled remainder of one) comes to rest.

fields.name: side
docs: 0 = Bid (buy Yes), 1 = Ask (sell Yes) — mirrors `OrderSide`'s ordinal.

fields.name: size
docs: Remaining size that came to rest (post any immediate fills).

types.name: OrderSide
docs: Which side of the (Yes-vs-USDC) order book an order rests on.

types.name: Outcome
docs: Settlement outcome of a market.

types.name: PairMinted
docs: Emitted when a user mints a Yes/No pair (F-02).

fields.name: amount
docs: Token base units of each side minted (== USDC base units deposited).

types.name: PauseSet
docs: Emitted when the admin sets the global pause flag (true = paused).

fields.name: price
docs: Limit price in USDC-per-Yes at PRICE_SCALE. Ignored when `is_market`.

fields.name: size
docs: Order size in Yes-token base units.

fields.name: is_market
docs: Market order: cross at any price, fill-or-cancel the remainder (no rest).

types.name: RedeemSide
docs: Which outcome token the caller is redeeming.

types.name: Redeemed
docs: Emitted when a user redeems settled tokens (F-02).

types.name: StrikeAdded
docs: Emitted when an additional strike market is provisioned intraday for an
already-trading ticker/day. Distinguishes an intraday add from the day's
initial provisioning for indexers and the automation service.

types.name: Ticker
docs: The supported MAG7 underlyings. Encoded as a `u8` discriminant on-chain.
Note: no explicit discriminants — borsh 1.x (Anchor v1) derives ordinal
encoding, and adding explicit `= N` values conflicts with the Anchor derive
macros. The ordinal order below *is* the on-chain encoding; do not reorder.

types.name: TickerConfig
docs: Per-ticker configuration: which underlying and its oracle feed id.
The `feed_id` is a 32-byte Pyth feed identifier (the on-chain settlement
feature, F-04, uses it to validate the price update account). Stored as raw
bytes so it is oracle-implementation-agnostic at this layer.

constants.name: PAYOFF_UNIT
docs: The number of base units that represent **$1.00**.
`1.00 USDC = 1_000_000` base units (because `10^6`).
A winning token redeems for exactly `PAYOFF_UNIT` USDC base units.

constants.name: PRICE_SCALE
docs: Order prices are integers in USDC-per-Yes at 6-decimal scale.
The price domain is `[0, PRICE_SCALE]` i.e. `[$0.00, $1.00]`.
Example: a Yes price of $0.65 is `650_000`.

constants.name: TOKEN_DECIMALS
docs: Decimals for the Yes/No outcome tokens. We mirror USDC (6) so that token
base units map 1:1 to collateral base units: minting 1 pair deposits
`PAYOFF_UNIT` USDC base units and issues `PAYOFF_UNIT` of each token.

constants.name: USDC_DECIMALS
docs: Decimals for the collateral token (USDC). USDC on Solana has 6 decimals,
so all monetary amounts are expressed in USDC base units.
